182894.overview:
Oh No! More Lemmings is the follow-up to Lemmings. The game features 100 new levels, and all new graphics and music. It was released for the SAM Coupé as an expansion pack for the original Lemmings game.

In order to play the new levels, you have to load the original Lemmings game, select “New Level” and enter the code “HNBVBVPN”. It will prompt for the “Data Disc” at which point you insert the “Oh No! More Lemmings” disk. The new game data will load - this includes adding one new difficulty level. The levels are now: Tame, Crazy, Wild, Wicked and Havoc.
